## SCENE 01: The Bottomless Feed
image: s01_short1_hook
prompt: Bob stands in the center holding a phone while a long doodle ribbon of blank rectangles unrolls from it and curls upward. Left and right thirds empty. Plain white background, compose for 16:9 with everything important in the center 9:16 area.
music: none

### Narration
(deadpan) {cam:zoom_in|6}{text:NO BOTTOM|slam} Your feed has no bottom. [pause:beat] That's on purpose.
(flat) {text:LAST PAGE|pop} A newspaper had a last page. {sfx:pop} A show had credits. {text:BACK COVER|fade} A book had a back cover.
(smug) {cam:punch_in}{text:STOPPING CUES|pop} Those were stopping cues. Little signals that said, "Okay, you're done."
(deadpan) {sfx:whoosh} The feed removed them. {text:NEW POSTS|jitter} New posts load on their own, so there's never {cam:punch_in} a page to turn.

(fake fancy) {text:INFINITE BUFFET|slam} Imagine a buffet that refills itself while you chew.
